name: CleanShift — Cleaning Business Scheduler
description: A scheduler for residential and commercial cleaning: manage clients and teams, book and dispatch jobs, run quality checks, keep supplies stocked, and resolve client issues. Includes 6 forms and 1 app.

packMeta.name: CleanShift — Cleaning Business Scheduler
packMeta.description: A scheduler for residential and commercial cleaning businesses: keep client and access details, dispatch cleaning teams, run the daily job sheet, sign off quality checks, watch supply levels and resolve client issues — all linked together.
packMeta.author: FormLogic

forms.title: Client
forms.description: Add a cleaning client with contact details, address, access instructions and billing status.

fields.label: New Client
fields.description: Add a client with their property details and access notes so every crew arrives prepared.

properties.placeholder: Key safe code, alarm, gate, parking, pets…
Preferences, product sensitivities, rooms to skip…

forms.title: Team
forms.description: Add a cleaning crew with its lead, members, vehicle and the areas of the city it covers.

fields.label: New Team
fields.description: Set up a cleaning crew so you can assign jobs and see who covers which part of town.

properties.placeholder: Names of the cleaners on this crew…

forms.title: Cleaning Job
forms.description: Schedule a cleaning job for a client with the team, date, time, duration, status and price.

fields.label: New Cleaning Job
fields.description: Book a job onto the run sheet, link the client and crew, and keep the whole day organised.

properties.placeholder: Anything the crew should know for this job…

forms.title: Quality Check
forms.description: Sign off a completed job against a checklist, rate the result and flag any follow-up.

fields.label: New Quality Check
fields.description: Walk the checklist, score the clean and note anything that needs a revisit.

forms.title: Supply Item
forms.description: Track a supply in the cupboard with its stock level, reorder point, unit and status.

fields.label: New Supply Item
fields.description: Keep an eye on chemicals, cloths and equipment so a crew never turns up empty-handed.

forms.title: Client Issue
forms.description: Log a client complaint, damage or access problem, set its severity and track it to resolution.

fields.label: New Client Issue
fields.description: Capture what went wrong, how serious it is and who is putting it right.

properties.placeholder: What happened, in the client’s words if you have them…
What was done to put it right…

apps.name: CleanShift
apps.description: A cleaning operations hub: keep clients and crews, run the daily job sheet, sign off quality checks, watch supply levels and resolve client issues from one dashboard.

roles.name: Operations Manager
roles.description: Full access to every CleanShift form.

roles.name: Dispatcher
roles.description: Coordinators who manage clients, crews and the run sheet, and log client issues.

roles.name: Cleaner
roles.description: Field crew who work jobs, sign off quality checks, log issues and update stock.

blocks.title: Cleaning operations overview
blocks.body: This report summarises cleaning job activity, revenue and client issues across the business. Use it to track workload, see which teams and job types carry the most work, and monitor how the operation is trending month to month.
